title: Naturality of the inverse right unit with ordinary constant coefficients
statement: For every commutative ring A, every scheme X, and every morphism f:K->Kprime in the ordinary unbounded derived category of A-module sheaves on X_et, f followed by the inverse of derivedTensorSingleUnitIso(Kprime) equals the inverse of derivedTensorSingleUnitIso(K) followed by tensor(f,id_{A_X}). The tensor and constant coefficient object are exactly those of def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows. No finiteness, torsion, invertibility or Noetherian hypothesis is required.

source.place: Definition of h by inverse tensor right unit, Chern class, and evaluation; the base-change argument uses naturality of this right unit.

proof.text: For an abstract coefficient category, express the inverse constant-unit comparison as the inverse derived right unitor followed by tensoring with singleFunctorObjUnitIso.inv. This is the comparison constant_unit_iso in lem-asd-ordinary-finite-derived-right-unit-pullback.

The composite is the component of derivedTensorRightUnitorInvComp. Its naturality, which follows from inverse right-unitor naturality and tensor interchange, gives the desired equation. Specialize the coefficient category to ModuleCat A and retain the prescribed ordinaryFiniteTensor and ordinaryFiniteUnit encodings. This is purely categorical and also applies to zero coefficients and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteSingleUnit_naturality (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {K K' : DerivedCategoryModule A X} (f : K ⟶ K') :
    f ≫ (derivedTensorSingleUnitIso K').inv = (derivedTensorSingleUnitIso K).inv ≫
      ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A X).map f).app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A X)
